images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of uncertainty-aware weak-to-strong escalation and post-handoff oversight. A weak agent goes through the task until its uncertainty scores trigger initial or step-level escalation; otherwise, the weak agent continues. After escalation is triggered, the strong agent retains control while the weak agent changes its role from an actor to a shadow observer for continued monitoring. The feedback path from weak observer to strong actor enables uncertainty-triggered reflection and intervention. In short,LEASHunleashes the strong agent only when the weak agent’s latent uncertainty signals it is needed, and keeps it on a leash afterward.

Figure 9:Runtime escalation case study II: photo selection.The weak agent enters a repeated open–inspect–close loop. After handoff at step 8, the strong agent changes to keyboard navigation and multi-selection and successfully creates the requested archive.

Figure 10:Runtime escalation case study III: extension installation.The weak agent continues browsing without completing the installation. After handoff at step 24, the strong agent switches to a terminal-based installation strategy and successfully installs the requested extension.
